fields.System.Title: CNT-204 — Freeze a location during a count
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an inventory controller, I want a location's stock held still while it is counted, so
that the variance reflects a real difference rather than a movement that happened mid-count.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a count task is assigned, then the location is frozen and the expected quantity
  • per product and batch is snapshotted at that moment.
  • - Given a frozen location, then no new pick, putaway, or replenishment task is issued
  • against it.
  • - Given a movement occurs against a frozen location despite the freeze, then the count is
  • voided rather than producing a variance.
  • - Given the count is submitted or cancelled, then the freeze is lifted.
  • - Given a freeze older than a configured timeout, then it is lifted automatically and
  • the count voided, so a location is never frozen indefinitely.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | counting, inventory |
| Tables | count_task, snapshot, stock_balance |
| Risks | Stock moving mid-count is the most common counting bug ([doc 09 §6.1](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · concurrency (movement during count) |
